options.name: asm_config
options.description: The Automated Scope Management configuration for the IP space.

options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the IP space. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: compartment_id
options.description: The compartment associated with the object. If no compartment is associated with the object, the value defaults to empty.

options.name: ddns_client_update
options.description: Controls who does the DDNS updates. Valid values are: * I(client): DHCP server updates DNS if requested by client. * I(server): DHCP server always updates DNS, overriding an update request from the client, unless the client requests no updates. * I(ignore): DHCP server always updates DNS, even if the client says not to. * I(over_client_update): Same as I(server). options.name: ddns_conflict_resolution_mode
options.description: The mode used for resolving conflicts while performing DDNS updates. Valid values are: * I(check_with_dhcid): It includes adding a DHCID record and checking that record via conflict detection as per RFC 4703. * I(no_check_with_dhcid): This will ignore conflict detection but add a DHCID record when creating/updating an entry. * I(check_exists_with_dhcid): This will check if there is an existing DHCID record but does not verify the value of the record matches the update. options.name: ddns_domain
options.description: The domain suffix for DDNS updates. FQDN, may be empty. Defaults to empty.

options.name: ddns_generate_name
options.description: Indicates if DDNS needs to generate a hostname when not supplied by the client. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: ddns_generated_prefix
options.description: The prefix used in the generation of an FQDN. When generating a name, DHCP server will construct the name in the format: [ddns-generated-prefix]-[address-text].[ddns-qualifying-suffix]. where address-text is simply the lease IP address converted to a hyphenated string. Defaults to "myhost".

options.name: ddns_send_updates
options.description: Determines if DDNS updates are enabled at the IP space level. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: ddns_ttl_percent
options.description: DDNS TTL value - to be calculated as a simple percentage of the lease's lifetime, using the parameter's value as the percentage. It is specified as a percentage (e.g. 25, 75). Defaults to unspecified.

options.name: ddns_update_on_renew
options.description: Instructs the DHCP server to always update the DNS information when a lease is renewed even if its DNS information has not changed. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: ddns_use_conflict_resolution
options.description: When true, DHCP server will apply conflict resolution, as described in RFC 4703, when attempting to fulfill the update request. When false, DHCP server will simply attempt to update the DNS entries per the request, regardless of whether or not they conflict with existing entries owned by other DHCP4 clients. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: default_realms
options.description: The IDs of the default realms in which the IP Space participates.

options.name: dhcp_config
options.description: The shared DHCP configuration for the IP space that controls how leases are issued.

options.name: dhcp_options
options.description: The list of IPv4 DHCP options for IP space. May be either a specific option or a group of options.

options.name: dhcp_options_v6
options.description: The list of IPv6 DHCP options for IP space. May be either a specific option or a group of options.

options.name: header_option_filename
options.description: The configuration for header option filename field.

options.name: header_option_server_address
options.description: The configuration for header option server address field.

options.name: header_option_server_name
options.description: The configuration for header option server name field.

options.name: hostname_rewrite_char
options.description: The character to replace non-matching characters with, when hostname rewrite is enabled. Any single ASCII character or no character if the invalid characters should be removed without replacement. Defaults to "-".

options.name: hostname_rewrite_enabled
options.description: Indicates if client supplied hostnames will be rewritten prior to DDNS update by replacing every character that does not match I(hostname_rewrite_regex) by I(hostname_rewrite_char). Defaults to I(false).

options.name: hostname_rewrite_regex
options.description: The regex bracket expression to match valid characters. Must begin with "[" and end with "]" and be a compilable POSIX regex. Defaults to "[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]".

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the object

options.name: inheritance_sources
options.description: The inheritance configuration.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the IP space. Must contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the IP space in JSON format.

options.name: vendor_specific_option_option_space
options.description: The DHCP Option Space resource identifier.
